# Open URL

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Opens the given URL.

## Syntax

~~~~text
openURL(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
openURL(url: "https://Jellycuts.com")
~~~~
